title_sq: Prane Pazarit te Ri, Shitet Apartament 1+1, me Vendndodhje Perfekte!
description_sq: Ne zonen e Pazarit te Ri, ne rrugen Tefta Tashko, Shitet Apartament 1+1, ne katin e katert te nje pallati egzistues 5 katesh. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe neto prej 64 m2 dhe organizohet nga korridori hyres, ambienti i ndenjes, me dalje ne ballkon, ambienti i gatimit me vete, nje dhome gjumi dhe tualeti me dritare. Orientimi eshte jug-lindje, cka do te thote qe ka drite natyrale dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Gjithashtu eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per banim edhe per investim pasi kerkesat per qira afatgjate por dhe qira ditore jane shume te larta. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Near the New Bazaar, 1+1 apartment for sale, with a perfect location!
description_en: In the New Market area, on Tefta Tashko Street, 1+1 Apartment for sale, on the fourth floor of an existing 5-story building. The apartment has a net area of ​​64 m2 and is organized by an entrance corridor, a living room with access to the balcony, a separate kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom with a window. The orientation is south-east, which means that there is natural light and sun throughout the day. It is also a very good opportunity both for housing and for investment, since the demands for long-term rent and daily rent are very high. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
